paper.title: Beyond Meta-Reasoning: Metacognitive Consolidation for Self-Improving LLM Reasoning
paper.central_claim: MC2 consolidates role-attributable meta-reasoning traces into reusable hierarchical meta-knowledge, improving future reasoning and amortizing effort as experience accumulates, allegedly without gold supervision.

provenance.notes: Assigned model type sonnet -> gpt-6.1-sol; no independently verifiable model/session receipt available. Blind boundary maintained; no other seat/attempt read.

sections_read: Appendices A–I including algorithm,implementation,all tables and example cards
materials.notes: AppendixI Figure11–25 template captions are present but prompt image bodies are absent from extracted text; manifest offers no page_images. Algorithm and implementation sections provide reconstructable core interfaces; exact templates requested, no visual claims fabricated.

claims.text: MC2 improves reasoning across fourbenchmarks andfourbackbones.
claims.selection_vs_test: Online lessons built from previous target batches,including correctness tags; hyperparameters examined onMATH500
claims.allowed_conclusion: Reported online oracle-assisted within-distribution gains,notlabel-free generalization proof.

claims.text: Hierarchical retained meta-knowledge contributes beyond episodic loop.
claims.selection_vs_test: Algorithm uses previous batches for nextbatch; same target stream,notindependent frozen source
counterevidence: No fixed budget,global-only or equal-length shamlesson control
claims.allowed_conclusion: Scoped within-stream retained benefit,notimprover-level or pure cross-task gain.

claims.text: Reasoning improves steadily as experience accumulates.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Within a target-task stream, retained role lessons/prompt updates improve later-batch reasoning relative to the episodic role-loop control, under a protocol exposing binary correctness tags. Repeated-pass progress alone is task-level; noimprover-levelevidence.

G.reason: Specific recurring meta-control gap with named memory/control neighbors; independent lineage proof incomplete.

M.reason: Role-attributable contrasts and hierarchical lessons causally target repeated metacognitive effort; alternative abstraction unisolated.

X.reason: Algorithm,embedding,window,composerfallback andtrace schemas reconstruct core chain; exact image-onlytemplates inaccessible. Oracle bit flaw assigned toholdout only.

E.measurement.reason: Sharedanswerparsing and failure inclusion plus proxy-correctness/difficulty checks; noindependentverifieraudit;GPT5 guidance judge secondary only.

E.causality.reason: Memory-off and updates-onlycomparisons relevant; budgets and baseline modifications leave alternate explanations.

E.holdout.reason: Binarygold-derivedtags enterlearning;fivepassesreusebenchmark;warmstartcontinues targetupdates. Reject label-free/independenttransfer reading,not nonweight scope.

E.cost.reason: Outputtoken means andbudget sweep report partialexpense,but fullcomposer/distiller/consolidator,inputtokens,failedregeneration andwallclocknotaccounted.
